title: Migrate Zephyr tests from manual main() to ztest
description:
9 Zephyr tests still use manual main() instead of ztest macros. Migrate them for:
- Consistent test framework across Zephyr tests
- Better failure output (assertion location, not just exit code)
- Eliminated merge conflict bottleneck in main()

## Reference
- lichen/tests/util/ — already uses ztest (template)
- link_ctx Criterion migration shows the pattern (but for host tests)

## Tests to migrate
1. asn_sfn
2. coap_codec
3. drift_bound
4. hal_reset_unavailable
5. meshtastic_adapter_layout
6. pps
7. regional_duty_cycle
8. routing_dispatch
9. rpl_dao_timing (already has #ifdef CONFIG_ZTEST dual-mode, just needs cleanup)
